title: Core company document block v1
description: One of a company's documents for its customers (booking terms, shop terms, privacy policy, cancellation policy) as its own site shows it: the text of the version in force, in the page's language. Built by the server for the document's own page (`/documents/<name>/`) from the text a person approved; nobody writes it — a draft, an entry or a change set that carries it is refused (`serverBuilt` in the manifest). A document is written per language: where the version in force has no text in the page's language the block carries no `text` and names the languages that have one (ADR-072, slice 5f part 2; ADR-073 §9).

title.description: What the document is called, in the page's language.

effective_from.description: The day the version took force, as a calendar date.

text.description: The version's text in the page's language: plain text, paragraphs apart by an empty line. Absent where the version has none in that language.

elsewhere.description: Where the document can be read when the page's language has no text: its page on this site in each language that has one and the site is read in.
